observable_outcome: ci/components.json declares every real cross-component edge and no unjustified one, the component evidence key hashes the transitive closure of its dependencies' own files so that appending one byte to a dependency's non-test source moves the consumer's key, internal/ci proves both properties with positive controls that fail when an edge or a justification is removed, and all 23 component keys plus one aggregate are re-issued as fresh evidence bound to the judgment commit with make check green after the evidence is committed.
acceptance_criteria: A1. ci/components.json gains the field verification_dependencies on every component (empty list where it has none) and its dependencies are set to exactly the lists in dp-v2-045 d6 and d7. internal/ci parses both fields. Validate keeps rejecting a cycle in dependencies and must NOT apply the cycle check to verification_dependencies; add a test that a cyclic verification_dependencies pair (runner/reconciler, which is the real one) is accepted while the same pair in dependencies is rejected.

A2. Affected() is unchanged in behaviour. verification_dependencies is not read anywhere in Affected(), and TestAffectedReverseClosure plus every existing selection assertion still passes unmodified. Prove it by stating, in the evidence, that no line of Affected() was edited.

A3. evidenceKey is replaced by exactly the algorithm in dp-v2-045 d2, including the "agentic-loop/evidence-key/v2" version prefix, the length-prefixed framing of every variable-length field, the hashed closure id list, and the unconditional set [Makefile, ci/components.json, ci/key-closure.json, devbox.json, devbox.lock, go.mod, go.sum]. No map is iterated anywhere in the computation; every list is ordered by sort.Strings. The os.IsNotExist skip for staged-but-deleted files is kept unchanged.

A4. internal/ci exposes ListTracked(root) and EvidenceKeyFromFiles(root, files, m, c) and EvidenceKeyWithManifest is their composition. The manifest-free EvidenceKey(root, c) is deleted, not deprecated. cmd/ci-plan still calls EvidenceKeyWithManifest and its --keys, --candidate, --execute and --tracked behaviour is unchanged except for the key values.

A5. cmd/ci-plan gains --closure-out <path>, make gains a key-closure target, and ci/key-closure.json is tracked, containing version, key_version, the sorted unconditional path list, and one entry per component with sorted closure ids and a sorted deduplicated pattern list. It contains no evidence key and no hash of any kind. A golden test in internal/ci recomputes it from ci/components.json and fails on any byte difference; devbox run --pure -- make key-closure followed by git diff --exit-code ci/key-closure.json is clean.

A6. internal/ci/manifest_dependencies.go derives the import graph with go/parser over every tracked *.go file, reading only f.Imports, classifying test by the _test.go suffix, mapping directories to components with the manifest's own match(), and additionally deriving (b) module-path string literals from *ast.BasicLit and (c) the ./-prefixed packages and scripts/*.sh paths in each check target's Makefile recipe. go list is not invoked from any test.

A7. VerifyDependencyCoverage asserts, for every component, that declared dependencies is a superset of the derived non-test import edges and that dependencies union verification_dependencies is a superset of the derived (a)+(b)+(c) edges. It passes on the real manifest.

A8. VerifyNoUnjustifiedEdges asserts that every declared edge not present in the derived sets appears in a JustifiedEdges table with a written reason, seeded with exactly the three contract-read edges (internal-contracts->contracts, task-ledger->contracts, release->contracts) and no others, and that every module-path string literal not covered by the closure appears in a LiteralFalsePositives table, seeded with exactly the two internal/release/source_guard_test.go entries. It passes on the real manifest.

A9. VerifyCheckTargetInsideClosure asserts that every package and every script a component's check target executes is owned by a component inside that component's key closure. It passes on the real manifest.

A10. Six positive controls, each a named subtest, each failing when it should and passing when it should. PC1: an in-memory copy of the real manifest with runner's application dependency removed makes VerifyDependencyCoverage return an error naming runner and application. PC2: removing one JustifiedEdges entry makes VerifyNoUnjustifiedEdges return an error naming that edge. PC3: the AST extractor over a t.TempDir() fixture module finds the non-test import, finds the _test.go-only import and classifies it as test, finds the import inside a build-tag-excluded file, and does NOT report a string literal shaped like a module import path as an import. PC4: two synthetic components whose file sets differ only in how identical bytes split between path and content produce different keys (this is the framing control; state in the evidence that the old algorithm gives them the same key). PC5: appending one byte to a dependency's file moves the consumer's key AND leaves an unrelated component's key unchanged, the second half being the non-vacuity control. PC6: appending one byte to Makefile moves all 23 keys. PC4, PC5 and PC6 run over EvidenceKeyFromFiles with an injected file list in t.TempDir(); no test edits a tracked file and no test runs git.

constraints: Work only inside the assigned isolated task worktree; never push.
Never use git reset, git checkout --, git stash or git commit --amend.
Export PATH=/nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin:$PATH first, run everything through devbox run --pure -- <cmd>, and judge success by the verdict line, never by the exit code of devbox run.
Pass AGENTIC_LOOP_* style variables with devbox run --pure -e NAME=value, because --pure strips the inherited environment.
Do not run any real Provider CLI. Nothing in this task needs one, and ev-v2-017 must not be re-executed here.

Do not change Affected(), all_on_change, the ownership rule, or any component's roots, public_contracts, contract_dependencies or check block. Only dependencies changes, and verification_dependencies is added.
Do not split internal/quota out of the infra component and do not touch any component boundary.

Do not let internal/release import internal/ci or internal/update in any file, including test files; dp-v2-021 d12 forbids it and internal/release/source_guard_test.go enforces it. Read ci/key-closure.json instead.
ci/key-closure.json must never contain an evidence key or any hash. It is hashed into every key, so a key inside it would be an unsatisfiable fixed point.
Never mutate a tracked file inside a test. The key-sensitivity controls use EvidenceKeyFromFiles with an injected file list under t.TempDir().
Read the 23 evidence keys only after make check is green at commit A and after git add, because a file that is not in the git index is invisible to git ls-files and therefore to the key.
Regenerate ci/key-closure.json before reading any key: it is in the unconditional set, so a stale golden file changes every key.
Run devbox run --pure -- go clean -testcache before make evidence-all, so no inner make component-<id> can report a cached result.

.agents/v2/evidence/index.json is being edited concurrently by other implementers. After any rebase, re-add all 24 entries and recompute every evidence_hash on the final bytes; never resolve the conflict wholesale in favour of one side.
Do not touch .agents/v2/task-state/** or any file under .agents/v2/packets/**; the coordinator records transitions and two other Tech Leads are writing packets concurrently.
Japanese prose for the tracked documents, matching the surrounding sections; English for Go identifiers, comments and evidence summaries, matching the surrounding code.

Rollback is revert commit B then revert commit A, in that order, as two reverts. Reverting A alone leaves the 24 records attesting keys that no longer exist; reverting B alone leaves the ledger with no fresh key for any component. If the task must be abandoned after commit A has landed on v2, say so and stop: do not attempt a partial revert.

Escalate and stop, rather than working around, if: the derived non-test import graph cannot be made acyclic (E1: a real boundary defect, and boundary redesign is a non-goal); ci/key-closure.json cannot serve internal/release and the only remaining option is an import of internal/ci (E2); V2-018 needs a provider-live-claude record that only a live claude run can produce (E3, see A18); make check is red for a reason outside allowed_paths, for example an unavailable Firestore emulator (E4); the aggregate cannot be made self-consistent beyond the documented task-ledger residual (E5); or any acceptance criterion turns out to require editing a prohibited path (E6).
